translations.web: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.
translations.bsb: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the great storm continued to batter us, we abandoned all hope of being saved.
translations.kjv: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
translations.asv: And when neither sun nor stars shone upon us for many days, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was now taken away.
